The '''RDD-7 racing [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle available in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] c. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. [[Grubber Vapps]] owned a customized RDD-7 named "[[Rudy (swoop)|Rudy]]."
